sections.instruction: Extract the event title, date, and venue from the single college event notice.
sections.context: A notice may contain reminders, registration details, and information copied from more than one source.
sections.constraints: Use the notice only. If sources disagree about a date or venue, choose the value mentioned last. Keep the organizer attached to the event name when they appear together. Copy other values as written.
sections.output_format: Return one JSON object with event, date, and venue. Use null when a field is missing.
